title: Why Analytical TP-Decode Latency Models Fail in Eager LLM Serving
summary_zh: 一項由量測驅動的負面結果：將單 GPU decode 延遲模型擴展至 tensor parallelism 的自然加性組合 $T_{compute}/k + 2 N_{layers} T_{allreduce}$ 無法預測 eager 模式 70B TP-decode 延遲。在受信任的 H100 網格上，組合在 TP-2 準確（2.86% MAPE）卻在 TP-4 未通過預先登錄的 15% kill-switch（42.3% MAPE，每個 cell 低估 32–45%），因為實測 step 從 TP-2 到 TP-4 僅縮減 1.12×（理想為 2×）。隱含的每步殘差隨 k 從 −2.5 偏移至 +8.0 ms。一個同節點 H100 對照重現此失效（1.08×、TP-4 44% MAPE），確認其為真正的 TP-scaling 效應而非節點變異。正面成分：一個 microbench 校準、免重擬合的 NCCL all-reduce 模型 $\lambda+\tfrac{2(k-1)}{k}b/\beta$，全域 $R^2>0.999$（但已揭露在 32–256 KiB 小 message 高估 7–27%）。成因與不縮減的 eager host/dispatch 成本相一致（無 Nsight；數個候選之一）。H200 decode 因病態節點排除。
summary_en: A measurement-driven negative result: the natural additive composition that extends a single-GPU decode-latency model to tensor parallelism, $T_{compute}/k + 2 N_{layers} T_{allreduce}$, does not predict eager-mode 70B TP-decode latency. On the trusted H100 grid the composition is accurate at TP-2 (2.86% MAPE) but fails its pre-registered 15% kill-switch at TP-4 (42.3% MAPE, every cell under-predicted 32–45%), because the measured step shrinks only 1.12× from TP-2 to TP-4 versus the ideal 2×. The implied per-step residual shifts from −2.5 to +8.0 ms with k. A same-node H100 control reproduces the failure (1.08×, TP-4 44% MAPE), confirming a genuine TP-scaling effect rather than node variance. The positive component is a microbench-calibrated, refit-free NCCL all-reduce model $\lambda+\tfrac{2(k-1)}{k}b/\beta$ with global $R^2>0.999$ (disclosed +7–27% over-prediction at 32–256 KiB). The cause is consistent with a non-shrinking eager host/dispatch cost (no Nsight; one of several candidates). H200 decode excluded as pathological.
